items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: His name was Josephus Robinson. A very good classical man.

ctx.x: Do you remember the name of your first piano teacher?

It was a lady, but I remember the guy that carried me down the road. His name was Josephus Robinson. A very good classical man. And oh, we used to have like church concerts and I used to have to go down and play some Mendelssohn and play a little Bach, you know, and I was so nervous I didn't know what I was doing. It turned out all right, you know, I just didn't want to disappoint my parents at that time. And they were pretty proud that their efforts were paying off.
Well, Mr. Robinson came after your earlier teacher, is that right?
